description: Point-in-time snapshot writer for asset outputs. After compute produces a value, serialize + write to fsspec URI keyed by <asset_name>/<code_version>/<timestamp>__<run_id>.<ext>. Format auto-detects: pandas.DataFrame → parquet, dict/list → json, bytes → bin, str → text, else pickle. Explicit format supported. Optional retention_days prunes older snapshots. Emits AssetObservation(snapshot_path, snapshot_bytes, snapshot_format, snapshot_pruned_count) so rollback becomes an event-log query. Snapshot write failures don't fail the asset (warn-only). Skips when run tag dry_run=true active. Companion @snapshot decorator.

outputs.description: One @dg.asset. Emits AssetObservation with snapshot metadata per successful write.

uri.label: Snapshot URI
uri.description: fsspec directory URI (s3://, gs://, abfs://, /local/path, etc.).

format.label: Format
format.description: Optional explicit format; null = auto-detect from returned value.

retention_days.label: Retention Days
retention_days.description: If set, delete snapshots older than N days from this asset's folder after each successful write.

code_version.label: Code Version
code_version.description: Sets the asset's code_version. Embedded in snapshot path so rollback tools can filter by version.

name: Snapshot Asset
